sources.snippet: A static embedding model for fse: the mean of the token rows of a text, normalized to unit length. On the 1,379 STS-B test pairs, raw float32 scored 48.52845 Pearson x100 and SIF-10 float32 scored 72.40582. Use raw for a plain mean of the source vectors.
